questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Security Fundamentals, Threat Models & Cryptographic Principles
questions.text: Explain the CIA Triad (Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability), Non-Repudiation, and Authentication in Cyber Security. Explain Active Attacks vs Passive Attacks with examples.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Symmetric Key Cryptography & Block Cipher Modes
questions.text: Explain Symmetric Key Cryptography: Data Encryption Standard (DES - Feistel cipher structure) vs Advanced Encryption Standard (AES - Substitution, ShiftRows, MixColumns, AddRoundKey).

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Symmetric Key Cryptography & Block Cipher Modes
questions.text: Explain Asymmetric Key Cryptography: RSA Algorithm. Given prime numbers $p = 7, q = 11$, and encryption key $e = 13$, compute private key $d$, encrypt message $M = 9$, and decrypt ciphertext $C$. Explain Diffie-Hellman Key Exchange and Man-in-the-Middle attack.
Explain Cryptographic Hash Functions (MD5, SHA-256) and Message Authentication Code (HMAC). Explain Digital Signatures (DSA) and Digital Certificates (X.509 standard).

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Message Integrity, Hash Functions, Digital Signatures & HMAC
questions.text: Explain Network Security Protocols: IPsec (AH and ESP protocols, Transport vs Tunnel mode), SSL/TLS Handshake Protocol, and HTTPS.

Explain Web and System Vulnerabilities: SQL Injection (SQLi), Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF), Denial of Service (DoS/DDoS), and Firewalls / Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS).
